YouTube fixes error 403
1. YouTube multilanguage audio bug fixed

1. Optimized and improved translations across all supported languages.
2. Fixed sign-in issues: improved Settings button behavior and added a sign-in status indicator in Settings.
3. Added enhanced error handling for video processing.
4. Fixed issue where videos were downloaded as MKV instead of MP4.
5. Bulk video/playlist improvements: added CSV export for both successful and failed downloads, and optimized download performance.
6. Added bulk audio bitrate selection for videos and playlists.
7. YouTube: Added support for scaled audio bitrate downloads up to 320 kbps.
8. Fixed issue in mpv media player where only audio played without video.
9. Bulk import/export enhancements: support for CSV/TXT files, with lists persisting even after closing the app.
10. Added new tips in the Tips window.
11. Improved permission error messaging when required permissions are not granted.
